'''''Predator''''' was the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] assassin [[Kell Douro]]'s personal ship. He used it to pursue [[Jaden Korr]] to the [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==Design and Modifications==
The ''Predator'' was a modified [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] owned by the Anzati assassin Kell Douro. Douro made many modifications to the ship, including a hyperdrive sled and sensor evading technology stolen from the [[StealthX]] design. ''Predator'' also had several stasis freezers in its cargo hold, which Douro used to keep his captured sentients for feeding.

==History==
The ''Predator'' was Kell Douro's personal ship for many years, up to [[41 ABY]]. In that year, Douro used the ship in his hunt for [[Jaden Korr]], under assignment for the [[One Sith]]. After Douro was killed by Khedryn Faal on the [[Frozen moon]], ''Predator'' was taken by the [[Community]], an escaped group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], who used the ship to flee the moon for the Unknown Regions.
